snippet.title: Fathom - Official Announcement Trailer | DevGamm Awards 2026
snippet.description: Check out the announcement trailer for Fathom, a desktop idler set beneath the waves of an alien ocean in the AETHUS universe. Fathom is developed by Pawsmonaut Games and will be available on PC in 2027. You can wishlist now on Steam if you're interested.
